items.title: Declaration of Good Standing
items.description: Please provide the Declaration of Good Standing (verzoek verklaring betalingsgedrag) of XYZ N.V. Kindly upload the document in the Extra Documentation section and name the file Declaration of Good Standing. Please note that the Declaration of Good Standing must be the official document issued by the Tax Authorities with the stamp of 'ontvanger' and the 'invorderaar' and it must be certified as a true copy.

items.description: Please add managing director Jonathan Heymans to the portal as a qualifying person and submit the Personal History Disclosure SHORT Form.

items.title: Compliance Officer
items.description: For a B2C application, it is required to appoint a compliance officer. Please add the compliance officer as a qualifying person in the portal and upload the Personal History Disclosure Form and enclosures (with the exception of source of wealth). A letter of engagement (signed by both the managing director Jonathan Heymans and the compliance officer) as well as a CV in English must also be submitted. Note: If the Compliance Officer already has a base application in the portal, upload the Personal History Disclosure Short Form and the letter of engagement in this application. The CV and all other enclosures must be submitted in the base application.
